citations.quote: Although fiduciary duty often encompasses the principles of loyalty, prudence, and care, Standard III(A) does not render all members and candidates fiduciaries.

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Standard III.A REQUIRES Members and Candidates to act with loyalty, prudence, and care to clients, placing client interests above their own and their employer's. III.B requires fair and objective dealing across clients in analysis, recommendations, and actions; fiduciary duty is mandate-relative and tied to the IPS.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Standard III(A) Loyalty, Prudence, and Care + III(B) Fair Dealing
